trigger.observed_behavior: MySQL reaches healthy, but the backend repeatedly fails before health because MakeTransactionsReceiptIdNullable20260901101931 calls changeColumn on an absent transactions table.
trigger.bounded_error: TypeORMError: Table transactions does not exist.
trigger.known_baseline_evidence: The repository contains entity mappings for accounts, categories, transactions and Goals, but no migration creates the first three tables. The existing Goals create-if-absent migration runs only after the failing transactions migration.
trigger.source_builds: Fresh backend and frontend production images pass.

migration.approach: Extend the currently pending migration with an idempotent create-if-absent path for categories, accounts and transactions before retaining its existing receipt_id-nullability behavior. Existing compatible tables and all existing rows remain untouched.
migration.ordering_reason: This migration is the active startup failure and executes before the existing Goals create-if-absent migration. Extending it avoids adding a later migration that cannot be reached.

tables.name: accounts
relationships: FOREIGN KEY user_id REFERENCES users(id) with no cascade change

tables.name: transactions
relationships: FOREIGN KEY account_id REFERENCES accounts(account_id) with no cascade change
FOREIGN KEY category_id REFERENCES categories(category_id) with no cascade change

compatibility_preflight: Require users to exist with unsigned primary key users.id before creating accounts; otherwise stop without mutation.

For any prerequisite table that already exists, validate the columns and referenced-key signedness needed by UC-13 before continuing; stop on an incompatible partial schema rather than altering it implicitly.
Create missing tables in categories, accounts, transactions order so every foreign-key target exists.
When transactions already exists, retain the previously approved UC-04 behavior that changes only receipt_id to INT UNSIGNED NULL.
When transactions is newly created with receipt_id already nullable, do not perform a redundant destructive rewrite.

data_and_rollback.forward_data_impact: Additive only for absent tables. No existing row is rewritten or deleted and no seed or fabricated financial data is introduced.
data_and_rollback.rollback: Use migration-specific table comments to identify tables created by this recovery path. Drop only migration-created tables, in transactions, accounts, categories order, and only while each is empty. Refuse rollback when any such table contains rows or when ownership cannot be proven.
data_and_rollback.persistent_volume: Preserve the existing Docker volume; no reset, prune or down -v operation is authorized.

runtime_verification_after_implementatio: Rebuild the backend production image through Docker Compose.
Start the existing persistent MySQL volume through the non-conflicting host-port override.
Verify database, backend and frontend health separately.
Perform only bounded UC-13 health, unauthenticated 401 and researcher-authorized authenticated goal observations.
Do not create or run tests.
out_of_scope: No users, Goals, bills or other table redesign
No seed data, backfill, data deletion or volume reset
No public API or Business Rule change
No correction of unrelated receipt_id TypeScript/API mapping drift
No test or test-case creation or execution

assumptions: The current failure proves transactions is absent but does not, by itself, prove whether accounts and categories are absent because migration execution stops first.
The create-if-absent and compatibility-preflight behavior is required to handle either a fully missing or partially present cumulative baseline without overwriting existing data.
The physical receipt_id contract remains INT UNSIGNED NULL as already approved in docs/02-construction/implementation/UC-04/schema.json; UC-13 does not read or expose receipt identifiers.
The existing Goals create-if-absent migration remains responsible for Goals after these prerequisite tables are available.

approval.approved_via: The researcher replied 'approve' immediately after the explicit request to approve the UC-13 schema proposal.
approval.scope: Approve the exact idempotent categories/accounts/transactions recovery contract above and the bounded migration implementation; approval does not authorize destructive rollback, seed data, or Docker volume reset.

pending_amendment.trigger_evidence: The approved recovery created empty categories, accounts and transactions tables and the receipt migration was recorded successfully. The following Goals migration then failed with ER_FK_INCOMPATIBLE_COLUMNS because Goals.category_id is INT UNSIGNED while categories.category_id is INT signed.
observed_metadata: MakeTransactionsReceiptIdNullable20260901101931 is recorded in the migrations table

required_change.migration: Add one TypeORM migration ordered immediately before CreateGoalsTableIfMissing20260903105626.
operations: Preflight categories and transactions and refuse any negative category identifiers.
Drop only the existing transactions.category_id foreign key temporarily.
Alter categories.category_id from INT signed to INT UNSIGNED without changing values, primary-key status or generation behavior.
Alter transactions.category_id from INT signed NULL to INT UNSIGNED NULL.
Recreate the transactions.category_id foreign key with its existing no-cascade behavior.
Update Category.categoryId and Transaction.categoryId TypeORM mappings to unsigned so source and physical schema agree.
Leave the already-approved Goals migration unchanged; it can then create its unsigned category foreign key.

pending_amendment.data_impact: No rows are created, rewritten or deleted. The migration must refuse execution if a negative category identifier exists. The Docker volume remains preserved.
pending_amendment.rollback: Before reverting to signed INT, remove only the affected category foreign keys, restore both columns to signed INT with their existing nullability, and recreate the original no-cascade transaction foreign key. Never drop a table or row.
out_of_scope: No Goal table redesign or change to the already-approved Goals migration
No receipt, account, user, bill, public API or Business Rule change
No seed data, volume reset or destructive cleanup

approval.approved_via: The researcher replied 'approve' immediately after the explicit UC-13-SCHEMA-RUNTIME-001 amendment request.
approval.scope: Approve unsigned category identifiers in categories and transactions, their matching TypeORM mappings, and the bounded foreign-key-preserving migration described above.
